{{Quote|And this is no place to be without ''transportation'' once those twin suns really start cookin'!|Han Solo|<ref name="sw32">[[Star Wars (1977) 32|''Star Wars'' (1977) 32]]</ref>}}
'''Tatoo II''', also known as '''G2''', was one of the [[Star/Legends|stars]] at the heart of the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]]. A [[Binary star/Legends|binary star]], its partner was [[Tatoo I/Legends|Tatoo I]].

==Description==
Tatoo II was a [[Star/Legends#Types of stars|G2-type]] main sequence [[Binary star/Legends|binary]] [[Star/Legends|star]], sister of G1-type [[Tatoo I/Legends|Tatoo I]]. They formed the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]] with the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], [[Ohann]], and [[Adriana]]. The system lay at the crossroads of the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]] and the [[Old Corellian Run]] in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] of the [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] segment.<ref name="Atlas" /> In [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]], the dominant [[Language/Legends|language]] on Tatooine, the twin suns were known as "Gi Dopa Gasha."<ref name="DMSC">''[[The Clone Wars: Darth Maul: Shadow Conspiracy]]''</ref>

Tatoo II was formed when a [[Hydrogen/Legends|hydrogen]] molecular cloud collapsed. Through most of the its life, energy was produced by nuclear fusion which converted hydrogen into [[Helium/Legends|helium]]. Each second, millions of metric tons of matter were converted into energy within Tatoo II's core, producing neutrinos and solar radiation. It had a lifespan of roughly ten billion years as a main sequence star.<ref name="Atlas" /> Tatoo II did not have enough mass to explode as a supernova. At the end of their lifespan, stars of its kind entered a [[Red giant/Legends|red giant]] phase, their outer layers expanding as the hydrogen [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] in the core was consumed and the core contracted and heated up.

===Culture===
Children on Tatooine would tell stories of huge, powerful [[Sun-dragon/Legends|dragons]] that lived inside the two great suns that shone down upon them. Smaller cousins of these dragons were said to live in the [[Fusion furnace/Legends|fusion furnaces]] that powered many types of machinery and vehicles.<ref name="EP3NOVEL">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref>

As a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] boy, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] would climb to the roof of his hovel at night, lie back, and imagine he was as far from Tatooine as possible. A [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] later, in [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], an 18-year-old Skywalker [[Mission to Fondor (Separatist Crisis)|found himself]] in the [[Fondor system/Legends|Fondor system]], 40,000 [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]] away from the hovel's roof, gazing up at the binary stars that he knew to be Tatoo I and Tatoo II—the twin suns of his home planet—and he imagined the day when he would return to Tatooine and free his enslaved mother, [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi]].<ref name="Star Wars Adventures 2: The Cavern of Screaming Skulls">''[[Star Wars Adventures 2: The Cavern of Screaming Skulls]]''</ref>

==History==
{{SeeAlso|Tatoo system/Legends#History{{!}}History of the Tatoo system}}
[[File:Dune_Sea_trek_TCW.png|thumb|right|250px|Anakin Skywalker, Ahsoka Tano and R2-D2 trek across the Dune Sea in front of Tatoo I and II]]
Some early explorers thought the first planet of the system to be a third star, because of its blazing light reflected by its sodium-rich deserts.<ref name="EP4NOVEL" />

Tatooine had a strong presence in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], which led the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] to the star system of Tatoo II. The collapse of their empire in [[25,200 BBY]] caused the system to be left alone for some millennia.

The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] explored the segment of the Slice in which Tatoo II was located during the [[Great Manifest Period/Legends|Great Manifest Period]] and the [[Indecta Era]]. By [[1004 BBY]], the nearby region belonged to the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]], including [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], a large region of the known galaxy controlled by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] species. After the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]] in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], the region remained in Hutt control until the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the system changed hand several times: its region was taken from the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] by the Empire during the [[Thrawn campaign]], but was left after the [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral's]] death. Later, the space around Tatoo II was controlled by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], until the [[Sith–Imperial War]] [[127 ABY|127]]&ndash;[[130 ABY]], when the [[Fel Empire]] conquered much of the known galaxy, but was quickly replaced by [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tatoo II was created for [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], but technically it appeared first in the [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]] of the film in [[December]] [[1976]], half a year before the premiere.

Although the famous binary sunset scenes depicted the two suns as being of similar size, other sources show one sun significantly larger than the other. No explanation for this has been given.
